_comment: Import the ChannelBench PKT pair (bottom half-width 10 m, side slope 1:3, 2 m bench 1.5 m above the bottom, slope 1:3 to ground) as assembly C3DF-Bench with the PKT embedded, then prove it builds: profiles, corridor, code lists. The PKTs were generated with: tools/pkt-forge/bin/out/PktForge.exe channel --name ChannelBench --bottom-half-width 10 --slope1-h 3 --bench-height 1.5 --bench-width 2 --slope2-h 3 --lining 0.3 --out examples/pkt
